evals.name: spec-names-in-repository-language
evals.prompt: /dev:feature Dodaj do CLI komendę, która robi kopię zapasową wszystkich notatek do osobnego folderu w katalogu projektu, z datą w nazwie pliku. Napisz tylko spec (Phase 1) do .context/specs/ i zatrzymaj się na bramce akceptacji — nie implementuj. Na końcu speca dopisz sekcję z proponowanym tytułem PR i wiadomością commita.
evals.expected_output: A spec whose prose may be Polish (the owner's language) but whose every decided name — the command, the backup folder, the file-name pattern, identifiers — is English, with an English PR title and commit message; the chat reply is in Polish.
files: fixture: a small English Bun CLI repo (README, CLAUDE.md, src/commands/add.ts, list.ts) whose gitignored CLAUDE.local.md says only '- Chat replies, plans and specs: Polish.' — no rule for the repository language
assertions: Every name the spec decides (CLI command, backup folder, file-name pattern, new file or identifier names) is English
The proposed PR title is English
The proposed commit message is English
The reply to the owner is in Polish
